text:
Jack McBain has 98 hits in 24 games, and that number is the headline. He has become Utah's enforcer of record: he fought Gabriel Landeskog after the Colorado captain's cross-check on Logan Cooley, laid a big hit on Gavin Brindley that Player Safety reviewed, and explained to KSL Sports why teams shouldn't mess with Cooley.

The hockey underneath is fine. He has seven points in 24 games at 13 minutes a night, and Utah takes 56% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on (expected goals measure the quality of chances), about what it does without him. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking credits him with clean exits, 71% with possession. Evolving-Hockey had opponents creating more with him on last season than against most forwards. A third-round pick by Minnesota in 2018, he has spent his whole NHL career with this franchise. Our range has him around 12 goals.
